title: Month/Year view control uses role="tablist"/"tab" without the tab keyboard pattern
detail: The Month/Year toggle is marked up as `<div className="viewseg" role="tablist" aria-label="Calendar view">` wrapping two `role="tab" aria-selected={...}` buttons. Per the ARIA tab pattern this markup promises to a screen-reader/keyboard user: Left/Right arrow keys move selection between tabs, and each tab is wired to its panel via aria-controls (with a matching role="tabpanel"). Neither exists: there is no onKeyDown handler anywhere on these buttons or their container (confirmed — the only onKeyDown handlers in the whole file are on unrelated text inputs at lines 4035, 4281, 5357, 5579, 5597), and `aria-controls`/`role="tabpanel"` appear nowhere in the file.
failure: A screen-reader user tabs to the control and hears "Month, tab, 1 of 2, selected" — the standard tab-pattern announcement — and, following that pattern, presses the Right arrow key expecting focus/selection to move to "Year". Nothing happens; they have to already know to abandon the arrow-key convention and Tab past it instead.
fix: Either implement the real pattern (roving tabindex + arrow-key handler that calls setCalView, plus aria-controls pointing at a role="tabpanel" wrapping the YearList/cal-vscroll region), or drop role="tablist"/"tab"/aria-selected and let it be a plain labeled button group — a segmented control doesn't have to be ARIA tabs.
